description: Department of Census and Statistics - The National Consumer Price Index - June 2024
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the National Consumer Price Index figure for June 2024. It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) and does not fit any of the specialized categories (land, legal, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial). The content represents statistical reporting by the Department of Census and Statistics, which falls under general administrative matters not specifically covered by the other categories, making it Miscellaneous (Type 10).
